leadText:
Jeffrey (Japanese: イサナ Isana) is a minor recurring character in . He is from Mocha Town.

Jeffrey debuted in Gymbaliar!. He challenged Jessie at 's fake Gym. His easily defeated Jessie's Dustox. After his victory, he was given a Badge. Jeffrey then ran off, bragging about his fake Badge and believing it was real. He did not appear again during the remainder of the episode, even after Team Rocket's scheme was exposed.

Jeffrey reappeared in An Old Family Blend!, where he was seen registering for the Lily of the Valley Conference with his . However, he was not shown during the match-up process, indicating that he did not make it through. Whether or not this was because of his fake Badge or if he was defeated in an unseen preliminary round is unclear.
